title: NetworkNodeReportRequest
description: network.node-report-request@1: POST /internal/nodes/report on OpenVibe.Network (capability network.node.report, held by the Host principal). The complete set of nodes one Host inventory knows, with their health now: a node absent from a later report of the same source is marked down, never deleted silently.

source.description: The reporting inventory (e.g. the host id).
